card.capacity_status_quote: We are now seeing NAND demand significantly in excess of our available supply for the foreseeable future.
card.demand_direction_quote: We are seeing an acceleration in NAND-based demand in the data center due to AI use cases such as vector database and KV cache offload
card.pricing_power_quote: Prices increased in the mid-sixties percentage range, driven by tight industry conditions, and included favorable mix.
card.guidance_direction_quote: For fiscal Q3, we anticipate exceptional growth across revenue, gross margin, EPS, and free cash flow.
card.constraint_owner_quote: Both AI and traditional server demand are constrained by lack of adequate DRAM and NAND supply.
